Updated the Treasury Bulletin bond-yields skill with a concrete ES95 rule:

For historical portfolio return ES on yield values, compute consecutive returns first, sort worst-to-best, and for small samples use at least one tail observation: ceil((1-confidence) * n_returns), minimum 1. For 10 January levels giving 9 returns, ES95 is the single worst return, preserving the negative sign.

Also compactly updated memory with the same durable rule.
